title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: EMPOWER!-Enabling Meaningful Participation of Women and girls for Essential Rights- has the goal of protecting and empowering the most vulnerable women and girls in Azaz, North West Syria. EMPOWER aims to address GBV and child protection concerns through prevention, response, and referral pathways. The use of safe spaces is at the core of the programme, providing protection and response services for the most vulnerable women and children and girls, while also raising awareness and working with key stakeholders to shift harmful behaviours and practices. The project will reach 12,000 women, men, girls and boys with protection services in 2023.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Improved protection services and empowerment opportunities for the most vulnerable women and girls. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The EMPOWER! programme is supporting the social and economic empowerment and provision of protection services for the most vulnerable women and girls in North West Syria. The programme is increasing the knowledge awareness and capacity of communities to address gender norms and practices affecting women and girls, improving access to appropriate quality psycho-social support and response services for at risk women, girls and boys and providing economic opportunities for vulnerable women.
